# Version 4.153.0
> **m153 engine preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 engine update with upstream correctness fixes. Linux font fallback can select a different face after this update; applications requiring deterministic text output should use explicit or bundled typefaces.

## Breaking Changes

- **Linux font fallback may select a different face** — Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the earlier FcFontSort path, which can change fallback glyphs or text metrics. Use an explicit family and style or a bundled typeface when deterministic font selection matters.

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m153** — Updates the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 153 and incorporates subsequent upstream correctness, buffer-upload, and servicing fixes. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927), [#5062](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5062), [#5116](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5116))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.300

HarfBuzzSharp packaging was updated to keep native compiler-warning suppression scoped to the affected code.
